chime.plan:
1. Pick up Shaker1 (needs free hand; Shaker1 empty, clean, on table).
2. Add ingredient2 to Shaker1 from Dispenser2 (needs Shaker1 held, Dispenser2 available).
3. Add ingredient1 to Shaker1 from Dispenser1 (needs Shaker1 held).
4. Shake Shaker1 to make cocktail2 (needs Shaker1 containing both ingredients).
5. Pour Shaker1 into Shot1 (needs Shot1 clean/empty, Shaker1 held with cocktail2).
6. Pick up Shot7 (needs free hand; Shot7 clean/empty).
7. Fill Shot7 with ingredient3 from Dispenser3 (needs Shot7 held, Dispenser3 available).
8. Place Shot7 down (needs free hand or held Shot7).
Ordering: steps 1–5 before step 6 only if hands conflict; otherwise 6–8 can be done after 5. Shot1 must be filled before goal check; Shot7 must contain ingredient3 before goal check.
